series_1: HANDLES -- title-independent reachability via exact-derived handle sets
CHAIN -- served derivations with typed frontier refusals
TWO WITNESSES -- checked independence of two readings
BRIDGE -- sufficient-condition refusals with a closed prove-S loop
NOTARY -- composable receipts and void propagation
series_2: ERRATUM -- typed-delta replay of served history against growth
REBUTTAL -- adjudicated two-way correction with checker-discharged rebuttals
EXIT SIGN -- refusals carrying executed question-repairs
COLD RECEIPT -- receipts that survive the program's deletion
LONG CON -- sequence-level adversarial search over conversations
series_3: LEDGER -- cost as a production-vs-recheck ratio (the five-cycle-parked cost lane returning)
CANARY-CURVE -- declared scaling classes frozen before growth + the architecture-vs-smallness split
PAUPER -- the cheapest-machine certificate with a partition-not-pass rule
CEILING -- cost as a typed refusal with a named price
BITROT -- fault-injection scope for exactness on unfaithful hardware

preregistration_draft.larger_move: Reachability of a statement should be a property of its verified content, not of the string someone typed above it. Derive, by exact code only, a tagged handle set per statement from parsed bodies and checker-elaborated terms; delete titles; publish what survives as an enumerated partition with a named cause per residue member.
preregistration_draft.artifact: handles.tbl (statement_id, handle_token, producer S1..S5, producer_run_id, resolves_to_count, title_derived, specific = resolves_to_count <= 128) + partition.tbl (REACHABLE | RESIDUE with cause) + enum.receipt (candidates with handle_witnesses, budget_used, measured_verification_cost_s, outcome, route_voids[])
preregistration_draft.gate: B1 every handle tagged; B2 K=128; B3 ablation deletes titles and title-derived handles; B4 residue enumerated, UNCLASSIFIED <= 5%; B5 Q60 frozen 42/18 incl. the zero-candidate question at floor 1/1; B6 13/13 silent-bind questions emit choice events; B7 two sealed classes, B=40, chance 40/12777; B8 permuted control; B9 rider floors
preregistration_draft.voiding_sentence: If the permuted index reaches its target on >=5 of the 42 present-target questions, reachability as defined here carries no signal and the capability claim is void regardless of how the true index scored
preregistration_draft.residual_risk: specific-but-inhuman handles: near-unique internal tokens pass every gate while no human question contains them; Q60 authorship is the unmeasured link between reachability-in-principle and reachability-by-a-person
